"""Compact paired-case result; retains own witnesses and reproducible sources."""

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES=('a12-forward','a12-rear','a12-left','k12-right','k12-rear','a1-rear')


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def summarize():
    pins={};direct_pins={};closures=[]
    def read(path):
        path=Path(path);pins[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(path)
        direct_pins[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(path)
        return json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    def ref(path):
        path=Path(path);pins[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(path)
        direct_pins[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(path)
        return {'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(path)}
    def require(condition,message):
        if not condition:raise ValueError(message)
    layout=read(BASE/'layout-attempt03/layout.json')
    clearance=read(BASE/'clearance-attempt02.json')
    closures.append(ref(BASE/'clearance-attempt02.json'))
    for path,digest in clearance['source_sha256'].items():
        require(pins.get(path,digest)==digest and sha(ROOT/path)==digest,'clearance source changed: '+path)
        pins[path]=digest
    require(layout['all_added_axes_fully_backed'] and clearance['all_nominal_envelopes_clear'],'complete geometry preflight required')
    require(clearance['parent_geometry']==layout['parent_geometry'],'matching geometric parents required')
    matched=tuple(case for case in CASES if all((BASE/'cases'/str(n)/case/'attempt01/replay.json').exists() for n in (66,98)))
    require(set(matched)==set(CASES)-{'k12-rear'},'five complete paired replays and one recorded failed case required')
    failure=read(BASE/'cases/98/k12-rear/attempt01/failure.json')
    require('fresh body/global closure failed' in failure['error'] and failure['accepted_q'] is None
            and failure['accepted_actions'] is None,'failed body/global closure cannot supply accepted actions')
    variants={}
    inputs={n:read(BASE/parent/'inputs.json') for n,parent in ((66,'mechanics66-attempt04'),(98,'mechanics98-attempt01'))}
    unchanged=('geometry','parameters','scenario','timber_rows','fitting_poses','factory_holes','all_factory_holes',
               'fitting_port_bindings','shafts','panel_ids','floor_footprints','finished_receiver_wall_queries')
    require(all(inputs[66][k]==inputs[98][k] for k in unchanged),'paired frame/material/support input changed')
    require(inputs[98]['hillman_rows'][:66]==inputs[66]['hillman_rows'],'original66 descriptors changed')
    for n,data in inputs.items():
        case_rows=[];all_heads=[];all_panels=[]
        for case in matched:
            folder=BASE/'cases'/str(n)/case/'attempt01'
            field=read(folder/'field.json');r=read(folder/'components.json');check=read(folder/'replay.json')
            closures.append(ref(folder/'field.json'))
            require(field['response']['converged'] and check['false_screw_force_rejected'] and not check['production_admission_issued'],
                    'own converged force replay and negative control required')
            require(check['field']['sha256']==sha(folder/'field.json'),'own replay field changed')
            require(field['case_id']==r['case_id']==check['case_id']==case and field['trial_screws']==n,'mixed own case or variant')
            require(len(r['screws'])==n and len(r['panels'])==6,'complete screw/panel count required')
            for pointer in field['operator_bundle'].values():
                require(sha(ROOT/pointer['path'])==pointer['sha256'],'saved operator artifact changed')
                ref(ROOT/pointer['path'])
            for path,digest in field['source_sha256'].items():
                require(pins.get(path,digest)==digest and sha(ROOT/path)==digest,'field source changed: '+path)
                pins[path]=digest
            heads=[dict(s,case_id=case) for s in r['screws']]
            panels=[{'case_id':case,'panel':p['panel'],'component':component,**value}
                    for p in r['panels'] for component,value in p['components'].items()]
            all_heads.extend(heads);all_panels.extend(panels)
            peak=max(heads,key=lambda v:v['withdrawal_n'])
            family={}
            for prefix in ('bending','rolling'):
                rows=[p for p in panels if p['component'].startswith(prefix)]
                worst=max(rows,key=lambda v:v['size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'][1])
                family[prefix]={'maximum_reference_index_CD1':worst['size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'][1],
                    'maximum_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6':worst['conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds'][1],
                    'witness':worst,'conditional_CD1p6_exceedances':sum(p['conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds'][1]>1 for p in rows)}
            case_rows.append({'case_id':case,'screws':n,'state_id':field['state_id'],
                'peak_screw_head_tension_n':peak['withdrawal_n'],'peak_screw_axis_id':peak['axis_id'],
                'head_reference_index_CD1':peak['generic_head_ratio_CD1'],
                'head_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6':peak['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6'],
                'head_exceedances_conditional_CD1p6':sum(h['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6']>1 for h in heads),
                'bending':family['bending'],'rolling':family['rolling'],
                'full_gradient_inf_n':check['equilibrium']['gradient_inf_n'],
                'maximum_body_force_norm_n':check['equilibrium']['maximum_body_force_norm_n'],
                'maximum_body_moment_norm_nmm':check['equilibrium']['maximum_body_moment_about_reference_norm_nmm'],
                'raw_field':ref(folder/'field.json'),'component_references':ref(folder/'components.json'),
                'raw_operator_replay':ref(folder/'replay.json'),'operator_bundle':field['operator_bundle']})
        peak=max(all_heads,key=lambda h:h['withdrawal_n'])
        families={}
        for prefix in ('bending','rolling'):
            rows=[p for p in all_panels if p['component'].startswith(prefix)]
            worst=max(rows,key=lambda p:p['size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'][1])
            families[prefix]={'comparison_count':len(rows),
                'maximum_reference_index_CD1':worst['size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'][1],
                'maximum_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6':worst['conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds'][1],
                'exceedances_CD1':sum(p['size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'][1]>1 for p in rows),
                'exceedances_conditional_CD1p6':sum(p['conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds'][1]>1 for p in rows),
                'governing_witness':worst}
        variants[str(n)]={'cases':case_rows,'head':{'comparison_count':len(all_heads),
            'peak_tension_n':peak['withdrawal_n'],'generic_reference_n_CD1':peak['generic_head_reference_n_CD1'],
            'maximum_reference_index_CD1':peak['generic_head_ratio_CD1'],
            'maximum_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6':peak['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6'],
            'exceedances_CD1':sum(h['generic_head_ratio_CD1']>1 for h in all_heads),
            'exceedances_conditional_CD1p6':sum(h['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6']>1 for h in all_heads),
            'governing_witness':peak},**families,
            'favorable_all_gross_penetration_withdrawal':{
                'maximum_reference_index_CD1':max(h['generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_CD1']/h['gross_nominal_length_after_panel_mm'] for h in all_heads),
                'maximum_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6':max(h['generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_conditional_CD1p6']/h['gross_nominal_length_after_panel_mm'] for h in all_heads),
                'actual_thread_engagement_or_Hillman_capacity_qualified':False}}
    differences=[]
    for before,after in zip(variants['66']['cases'],variants['98']['cases'],strict=True):
        require(before['case_id']==after['case_id'],'paired case order differs')
        live=lambda data:[r for r in data['cases'] if r['case_id']==before['case_id']][0]['loads']
        climber=lambda data:[r for r in live(data) if r['id'].startswith('climber/')]
        require(climber(inputs[66])==climber(inputs[98]),'climber force or application changed')
        differences.append({'case_id':before['case_id'],
            'peak_head_change_percent':100*(after['peak_screw_head_tension_n']/before['peak_screw_head_tension_n']-1),
            'peak_bending_index_change_percent':100*(after['bending']['maximum_reference_index_CD1']/before['bending']['maximum_reference_index_CD1']-1),
            'peak_rolling_index_change_percent':100*(after['rolling']['maximum_reference_index_CD1']/before['rolling']['maximum_reference_index_CD1']-1)})
    prying=[]
    for n in (66,98):
        field=read(BASE/'cases'/str(n)/'a12-rear/attempt01/field.json')
        name='main_upper_left'
        normal=[row[2] for row in field['panel_generalized_coefficients'][name]['geometry']['axes']]
        dot=lambda vector:sum(a*b for a,b in zip(vector,normal,strict=True))
        loads=[r for r in field['body_applied_loads'] if r['body']==name]
        screws=sorted((r for r in field['panel_screw_actions'] if r['panel']==name),key=lambda r:r['withdrawal_n'],reverse=True)
        compression=0.
        for row in field['contact_actions']:
            if row['first']==name:compression+=dot(row['force_on_first_xyz_n'])
            elif row['second']==name:compression-=dot(row['force_on_first_xyz_n'])
        tension=sum(r['withdrawal_n'] for r in screws)
        applied=sum(dot(r['force_xyz_n']) for r in loads)
        require(abs(tension-compression-applied)<1e-5,'own panel normal free body failed')
        prying.append({'screws':n,'case_id':'a12-rear','panel':name,
            'external_outward_n':applied,'sum_head_tensions_n':tension,'outward_backing_compression_n':compression,
            'normal_free_body_residual_n':tension-compression-applied,
            'largest_two_fraction_of_all_tensions':sum(r['withdrawal_n'] for r in screws[:2])/tension,
            'largest_two_simultaneous_tension_and_lateral':[{'axis_id':r['axis_id'],'tension_n':r['withdrawal_n'],
                'lateral_n':r['lateral_n'],'point_xyz_mm':r['point_xyz_mm']} for r in screws[:2]]})
    snapshots={}
    for filename in ('prepare_mechanics.py','run_mechanics.py','replay_mechanics.py','audit_geometry.py','render_layout.py','verify_summary.py'):
        file=BASE/filename
        snapshots[filename]={'sha256':sha(file),'source':file.read_text()}
        ref(file)
    for path in ('scripts/eoere_98_screw_trial.py','docs/bolted-frame-development/panel98-trial-layout.svg',
                 'docs/bolted-frame-development/panel98-trial-axes.csv','uv.lock'):
        ref(ROOT/path)
    alias=ref(BASE/'mechanics66-attempt04/parent-index.json')
    require(alias['sha256']==layout['source_sha256']['docs/bolted-frame-development/development-revisions.json'],
            'exact layout-time index bytes must remain recoverable')
    require(all(sha(ROOT/path)==digest for path,digest in pins.items()),'source closure changed during summary')
    producer=Path(__file__).read_text()
    return {'schema':'eoere_current_panel98_paired_development_trial/v1','revision':layout['revision'],
        'parent_revision':layout['parent_revision'],'parent_geometry':layout['parent_geometry'],
        'question':'Does preserving66 axes and adding32 reduce short-term panel/screw reference exceedances on the same current enclosed-passage frame?',
        'layout':{'original66_axes_preserved':True,'main_panel_count':4,'screws_per_main_panel':20,
                  'unchanged_kicker_screws':18,'total98':98,'added32_fully_backed':True,
                  'all32_nominal_screw_envelopes_clear_against_1033_parts':True,
                  'drawing':ref(ROOT/'docs/bolted-frame-development/panel98-trial-layout.svg'),
                  'axis_table':ref(ROOT/'docs/bolted-frame-development/panel98-trial-axes.csv'),
                  'preflight':ref(BASE/'layout-attempt03/layout.json'),'clearance':ref(BASE/'clearance-attempt02.json')},
        'paired_scope':{'unchanged_frame_fields_verified':list(unchanged),'same_original66_mechanical_rows':True,
            'current_100_bolts_22_angles_solid_timber_cleats':True,
            'future_single_pin_legs_24_angles_plywood_cleats_included':False,
            'current_panel_holes_K_mass_ports_contacts_and_screw_gravity_refreshed':True,
            'panel_screw_axial_and_lateral_prior_n_mm':1000.,
            'native_FEA_performed':False,'historical_displacements_or_forces_used':False,
            'numerical_tolerances_weakened':False,'production_field_admission_issued':False},
        'case_coverage':{'attempted_per_variant':6,'complete_paired_case_ids':list(matched),
            'rejected_98_case_id':'k12-rear','failed_case_has_no_accepted_q_or_actions':True,
            'failed_result':ref(BASE/'cases/98/k12-rear/attempt01/failure.json'),
            'unpaired_66_k12_rear_field':ref(BASE/'cases/66/k12-rear/attempt01/field.json'),
            'six_case_strength_or_force_envelope_established':False,
            'aggregate_reference_counts_and_maxima_scope':'five completed paired cases only'},
        'variants':variants,'paired_changes':differences,
        'normal_free_body_diagnosis':{'same_loaded_panel_and_original_force':True,'states':prying,
            'result':'Added ties increase the sum of screw tensions and opposing backing compression in the compatible model. The same original upper-left rim4 remains highest; a new upper edge tie becomes second. Equal division by screw count misses this panel/backing prying.',
            'next_question':'Can the coordinated hidden-frame/header/backing revision shorten the loaded panel span and return its offset moment while limiting relative panel/backing opening at rim4? Preserve a justified screw/contact stiffness basis and actual combined head/anchorage resistance; adding ties alone is insufficient.'},
        'method':'Existing gross-stock Timoshenko timbers, refreshed six-panel spline operators, corrected four-port angles, common shafts and fixed rear-leg XY/compression-only floor law. Raw pre-solve operators independently replayed with source-owned point/load maps, full gradient and150body/global wrench closure; false0.01N screw force rejected.',
        'load_basis':{'one_climber_lb':250,'downward_multiplier':2,'downward_force_n':2224.11080763025,
                      'simultaneous_global_horizontal_n':300,'hold_outward_standoff_mm':100,
                      'accessory_mass_kg':25,'same_source_six_cases':list(CASES)},
        'duration':'CD1 and conditionalCD1.6 are reference scenarios; neither measured pulse duration nor an adopted climbing duration qualification. The APA1.6 wind/earthquake comparison is not an impact allowance. CD does not change stiffness, forces or steel resistance.',
        'limits':['Unmeasured1000N/mm screw stiffness and area-weighted contact priors do not bound physical response.',
                  'The98K12rear calculation failed the unchanged body/global closure gate and supplies no accepted forces. Five completed pairs are not a six-case envelope.',

"""Check proposed screw envelopes against the complete current occupied bank."""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.eoere_98_screw_trial import DOC, ROOT, module, parent_sources
from scripts.eoere_current_shop_followup import require, sha


def run(layout_path, output):
    import cadquery as cq

    layout = json.loads(layout_path.read_bytes())
    index, current, _, _, sources, pins = parent_sources()
    require(layout['parent_geometry'] == index['geometry']['receipt'], 'proposal parent changed')
    shop = json.loads((ROOT/DOC/'shop-assembly-v1/extended-cleat-followup-v1/current-model-followup-v1/inputs.json').read_bytes())
    helper = module(Path(shop['sources']['bounds_helper']['path']), 'panel98_bounds')
    native_ref = shop['sources']['native']
    require(sha(ROOT/native_ref['path']) == native_ref['sha256'], 'native source changed')
    native = json.loads((ROOT/native_ref['path']).read_bytes())
    scenes = []
    registry = {r['id']: r for r in native['parts']}
    for filename in ('eoere-bottom-rail-scene.json.gz', 'eoere-cleat-trim-scene.json',
                     'eoere-aligned-wire-scene.json.gz', 'eoere-adjusted-base-v3-scene.json.gz',
                     'eoere-cleat-extension-scene.json.gz', 'eoere-uniform-channels-scene.json.gz',
                     'eoere-kicker-clearance-scene.json.gz', 'eoere-selected-hardware-scene.json.gz',
                     'eoere-front-posts-4x6-scene.json.gz', 'eoere-narrow-channels-scene.json.gz',
                     'eoere-enclosed-passages-scene.json.gz'):
        path = Path('site')/filename
        layer = helper.asset(str(ROOT/path))
        ref = layer['layout_report']
        require(sha(ROOT/ref['path'])==ref['sha256'],'scene source changed')
        pins[ref['path']]=ref['sha256']
        record=json.loads((ROOT/ref['path']).read_bytes())
        for key in ('finished_solids','finished_panel_solids','changed_finished_solids'):
            registry.update({r['id']:r for r in record.get(key,[])
                             if r.get('variant') in (None,'base','common')})
        if filename == 'eoere-uniform-channels-scene.json.gz':
            layer = {'replacements': layer['common_replacements']+layer['base_replacements']}
        if filename == 'eoere-narrow-channels-scene.json.gz':
            layer = {'replacements': layer['replacements']['base']}
        pins[str(path)] = sha(ROOT/path)
        scenes.append(layer)
        if filename=='eoere-selected-hardware-scene.json.gz':
            intermediate=helper.compose_bounds(native,scenes)
            translated=[]
            for row in layer['translations']:
                box=intermediate[row['name']]['bounds']
                delta=row['translation_xyz_mm']
                translated.append({'name':row['name'],'fabrication':row['fabrication'],
                    'mesh':{'bounds_xyz_mm':[v+delta[i//2] for i,v in enumerate(box)]}})
            scenes.append({'replacements':translated})
    bank = helper.compose_bounds(native, scenes)
    for filename in ('occupied-aligned-wire-v1.json', 'occupied-adjusted-base-v3.json',
                     'occupied-extended-cleats-v1.json', 'occupied-uniform-channels-v1.json',
                     'occupied-kicker-clearance-v1.json', 'occupied-selected-hardware-v1.json',
                     'occupied-front-posts-4x6-v1.json', 'occupied-narrow-channels-v1.json'):
        record = json.loads((ROOT/DOC/filename).read_bytes())
        registry.update({r['id']: r for r in record['changed_finished_solids']
                         if r.get('variant') in (None, 'base', 'common')})
    study = json.loads((ROOT/current['checked_study']['path']).read_bytes())
    registry.update({r['id']: r for r in study['changed_finished_solids']})
    registry.update(sources)
    bottom_path=DOC/'occupied-bottom-rail-v1.json'
    pins[str(bottom_path)]=sha(ROOT/bottom_path)
    bottom=json.loads((ROOT/bottom_path).read_bytes())
    translations={'fastener_'+r['axis_id']:[b-a for a,b in zip(r['before_xyz_mm'],r['after_xyz_mm'])]
                  for r in bottom['changes']['Hillman_axes_moved']}
    require(len(translations)==4,'four retained lower-rail screw translations required')
    # Freeze the index as metadata: its subsequent changes cannot invalidate
    # this receipt's immutable geometric source closure.
    frozen_index=output.with_suffix('.parent-index.json')
    with frozen_index.open('x') as f:json.dump(index,f,sort_keys=True,indent=2)
    pins.pop('docs/bolted-frame-development/development-revisions.json',None)
    pins[str(frozen_index.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(frozen_index)
    pins[str(Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(__file__)
    check=index['geometry_registry_check']
    require(sha(ROOT/check['path'])==check['sha256'],'registry QA changed')
    pins[check['path']]=check['sha256']
    require(len(bank) == 1033, 'complete current occupied bank required')
    cache, exact, conflicts = {}, [], []

    def load(name):
        row = registry[name]
        require(sha(ROOT/row['path']) == row['sha256'], 'obstacle source changed')
        pins[row['path']] = row['sha256']
        if name not in cache:
            body=cq.Shape.importBrep(str(ROOT/row['path']))
            if name in translations:body=body.translate(cq.Vector(*translations[name]))
            cache[name]=body
        return cache[name]

    for added in layout['added_axes']:
        axis = added['axis']
        p, d = cq.Vector(*axis['origin_xyz_mm']), cq.Vector(*axis['direction_xyz']).normalized()
        shank = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(2.5,63.5,p,d)
        head = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(4.5,3.,p,-d)
        envelope = shank.fuse(head)
        b = envelope.BoundingBox()
        box = [getattr(b,a+e) for a in 'xyz' for e in ('min','max')]
        for name, candidate in bank.items():
            if name in (axis['panel'], axis['receiver']):
                continue
            other = candidate['bounds']
            if not all(min(box[2*i+1],other[2*i+1])-max(box[2*i],other[2*i]) > 1e-7 for i in range(3)):
                continue
            require(name in registry, 'missing exact obstacle: '+name)
            volume = envelope.intersect(load(name)).Volume()
            row = {'axis_id':axis['axis_id'],'other':name,'kind':candidate['kind'],
                   'intersection_volume_mm3':volume}
            exact.append(row)
            if volume > 1e-5:
                conflicts.append(row)
    for path,digest in pins.items():
        require(sha(ROOT/path)==digest,'source changed: '+path)
    result={'schema':'eoere_panel98_occupied_clearance/v1','parent_geometry':layout['parent_geometry'],
        'layout':{'path':str(layout_path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(layout_path)},
        'occupied_parts':len(bank),'new_screws':32,'exact_queries':exact,'conflicts':conflicts,
        'four_existing_screw_pose_translations_applied':True,'eight_catalog_nut_bound_translations_applied':True,
        'all_nominal_envelopes_clear':not conflicts,'source_sha256':pins,

        'native_solve':False,'physical_hardware_or_drill_dimensions_verified':False,

"""Current-geometry inputs using existing cached-solid and panel kernels only."""

import copy
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np

from scripts import eoere_current_response as response
from scripts.eoere_98_screw_trial import INDEX, ROOT, parent_sources
from scripts.eoere_current_shop_followup import require, sha


def write(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def prepare(layout_path, out, count):
    require(count in (66,98) and not out.exists(), 'fresh 66/98 variant required')
    layout = json.loads(layout_path.read_bytes())
    index, _current, posts, prior, sources, pins = parent_sources()
    require(layout['parent_geometry'] == index['geometry']['receipt'], 'layout parent changed')
    pins[str(layout_path.relative_to(ROOT))] = sha(layout_path)
    old, _, axes, _, legacy_pins = response.current_metadata()
    pins.update(legacy_pins)
    p = copy.deepcopy(old)
    p['geometry'] = copy.deepcopy(index['geometry']['receipt'])
    overrides = {r['axis_id']: r for r in posts['selected_stack_overrides']}
    for axis in axes:
        identity = axis['id']
        if identity in posts['axis_overrides']:
            axis.update(copy.deepcopy(posts['axis_overrides'][identity]))
            axis['nut_side_spacer_mm'] = overrides[identity]['nut_side_spacer_mm']
    for row in p['raw_gross_timber_rows']:
        profile = posts['profile_overrides'].get(row['name'])
        if profile:
            v = np.asarray(profile['vertices_luv_mm'])
            low, high = v.min(axis=0), v.max(axis=0)
            basis = np.asarray(profile['basis_grain_u_v_xyz'])
            start = np.asarray(profile['datum_xyz_mm'])+basis.T@np.array([low[0],(low[1]+high[1])/2,(low[2]+high[2])/2])
            row.update(start=start.tolist(),end=(start+basis[0]*(high[0]-low[0])).tolist(),
                       axis=basis[0].tolist(),section_u=basis[1].tolist(),section_v=basis[2].tolist(),
                       width_mm=float(high[1]-low[1]),depth_mm=float(high[2]-low[2]),
                       current_gross_post_profile=copy.deepcopy(profile))
    if count==98:
        sources.update({r['id']:r for r in layout['changed_panel_solids']})
        originals = {r['id']:r for r in p['hillman_rows']}
        for row in layout['added_axes']:
            p['hillman_rows'].append(copy.deepcopy(row['mechanical']))
            axis = row['axis']
            p['current_panel_machining_descriptors']['features'].append({
                'diameter_mm':5.,'direction_xyz':axis['direction_xyz'],
                'drill_size_or_physical_hole_qualified':False,'identity':axis['axis_id'],
                'kind':'conditional_screw_clearance','panel':axis['panel'],
                'removed_volume_mm3':np.pi*2.5**2*18.25625,'start_xyz_mm':axis['origin_xyz_mm']})
            template = originals[row['template_axis_id']]
            delta = np.asarray(row['mechanical']['point_xyz_mm'])-template['point_xyz_mm']
            shares = [r for r in old['auxiliary_metal_gravity_descriptors']
                      if r['id'].startswith('fastener_'+template['id']+'/')]
            require(len(shares)==2,'two original nominal metal shares required')
            for share in shares:
                extra = copy.deepcopy(share)
                extra['id'] = extra['id'].replace('fastener_'+template['id']+'/', 'fastener_'+axis['axis_id']+'/',1)
                extra['center_xyz_mm']=(np.asarray(extra['center_xyz_mm'])+delta).tolist()
                extra['basis']='same nominal Hillman envelope shares as template; added screw is unobserved'
                p['auxiliary_metal_gravity_descriptors'].append(extra)
    for source in sources.values():
        box=source['bounds_xyz_mm']
        if len(box)==6:
            source['bounds_xyz_mm']=[box[i:i+2] for i in (0,2,4)]
    require(len(p['hillman_rows'])==count,'exact variant screw census required')
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    (out/'producer-snapshot.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    write(out/'parent-index.json',index)
    pins.pop(str(INDEX),None)
    pins[str((out/'parent-index.json').relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(out/'parent-index.json')
    pins[str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(Path(__file__))
    ex,m = response.load('cached_exporter').a.generic()
    q = ex.load_query_methods(pins)
    report = {'axes':axes,'scenario':response.read({'path':ex.REPORT,'sha256':ex.REPORT_SHA})['scenario'],
              'finished_solids':[sources[r['name']] for r in p['raw_gross_timber_rows']]}
    panel_rows=[sources[name] for name in prior['panel_ids']]
    exporter=response.load('cached_exporter')
    bodies,observations,import_proof=exporter.import_current(ex,report,panel_rows,pins,q)
    profiles={r['name']:r for r in p['raw_gross_timber_rows']}
    query,names,wall_proof=exporter.wall_cache(ex,old,report,observations,profiles,q,m)
    names.update({id(body):name for name,body in bodies.items()})
    role_original,ends_original=ex.role_rows,ex.end_seats
    with patch.object(q.bore,'finished_bore_wall_intervals',query), \
         patch.object(ex,'role_rows',lambda a,method,volumes:response.spacer_roles(a,method,volumes,role_original)), \
         patch.object(ex,'end_seats',lambda a,surfaces,method:response.spacer_ends(a,surfaces,method,ends_original)):
        shafts,walls=ex.shafts(report,profiles,bodies,q,m)
    print('Current own shaft/wall descriptors extracted',flush=True)
    patches,direct,pair_census,faces=ex.contact_bank(bodies,sorted(profiles),prior['panel_ids'],q,p['parameters'])
    domains,flange_patches,flange_contacts=ex.flange_bank(p['fitting_poses'],report,bodies,faces,q,m,p['parameters'])
    print('Current contact domains extracted',flush=True)
    # Keep the original four-point support discretization on each foot. The
    # wider post's old four points are still on its current bottom face.
    footprints=copy.deepcopy(prior['floor_footprints'])
    for name,points in footprints.items():
        require(all(bodies[name].isInside(q.cq.Vector(*point),1e-5) for point in points),
                'retained floor support point outside current solid')
    owners=[{'id':r['id'],'kind':'panel' if r['id'] in prior['panel_ids'] else 'timber',
             'mass_kg':r['volume_mm3']*p['parameters']['wood_density_kg_m3']*1e-9,
             'center_xyz_mm':r['center_xyz_mm'],'mass_basis':'own current finished cached volume'} for r in observations]
    old_owners={r['id']:r for r in p['physical_owner_gravity_rows']}
    owners += [{'id':pose['id'],'kind':'fitting','mass_kg':old_owners[pose['id']]['mass_kg'],
                'center_xyz_mm':ex.fitting_centroid(report['scenario'],pose,m)} for pose in p['fitting_poses']]
    for shaft in shafts:
        roles=shaft['metal_roles'];mass=sum(r['mass_kg'] for r in roles)
        owners.append({'id':shaft['body'],'kind':'shaft','mass_kg':mass,
                       'center_xyz_mm':[sum(r['mass_kg']*r['center_of_mass_xyz_mm'][j] for r in roles)/mass for j in range(3)]})
    bridge=response.load('bridge').frozen()
    centroidal=bridge.driver.load(bridge.driver.CENTROIDAL,bridge.driver.CENTROIDAL_SHA,'panel98_centroidal')
    case_provider=bridge.load(bridge.PACKET/'raised-rail-cases-v1/cases.py',bridge.REUSED['raised-rail-cases-v1/cases.py'],'panel98_cases')
    roles=[{'id':r['id'],'owner':shaft['body'],'mass_kg':r['mass_kg'],
            'center_xyz_mm':r['center_of_mass_xyz_mm'],'basis':r['basis']} for shaft in shafts for r in shaft['metal_roles']]
    require(len(roles)==508 and len({r['id'] for r in roles})==508, '508 unique selected shaft metal roles required')
    cases,gravity=case_provider.frame.load_cases({'panel_machining':p['current_panel_machining_descriptors']},
        {'bodies':[r for r in owners if r['kind']!='shaft'],
         'bolt_gravity_components':roles+p['auxiliary_metal_gravity_descriptors']})
    cases=[r for r in cases if r['primary_load_basis'] and r['case_id']!='gravity-only']
    require(len(cases)==6, 'six primary load cases required')
    scenario=copy.deepcopy(p['material_scenario'])
    scenario.update(fitting_stiffness_basis=centroidal.SCENARIO,fitting_operator_correction=centroidal.correction_contract())
    for case in cases:
        for row in case['loads']:
            if row['id'].startswith('bolt-weight/') and row['body'].startswith('shaft/'):
                row['id']='physical-bolt-metal/'+row['id'].removeprefix('bolt-weight/')
    data={'schema':'eoere_panel98_current_first_order_inputs/v1','trial_screws':count,
        'source_sha256':pins,'geometry':index['geometry']['receipt'],'parent_layout':layout['revision'],
        'optional_2026_extra':False,'parameters':p['parameters'],'scenario':scenario,
        'timber_rows':p['raw_gross_timber_rows'],'base_bodies':[r for r in owners if r['kind']!='shaft'],
        'physical_owner_gravity_rows':owners,'fitting_poses':p['fitting_poses'],
        'all_factory_holes':p['all_factory_holes'],'factory_holes':copy.deepcopy(prior['factory_holes']),
        'fitting_port_bindings':p['fitting_ports'],'shafts':shafts,'panel_ids':prior['panel_ids'],
        'floor_footprints':footprints,'cases':cases,'case':cases[0],'gravity':gravity,
        'finished_receiver_wall_queries':walls,'finished_body_observations':observations,
        'direct_contacts':direct+flange_contacts,'hillman_rows':p['hillman_rows'],
        'current_panel_machining_descriptors':p['current_panel_machining_descriptors'],
        'flange_domains':domains,'flange_shared_face_patches':flange_patches,
        'timber_and_panel_shared_face_patches':patches,'shared_pair_query_census':pair_census,
        'historical_q':None,'old_field':None,'release':copy.deepcopy(p['release'])}
    for row in observations:
        pins[row['source']['path']]=row['source']['sha256']
    for path,digest in pins.items():
        require(sha(ROOT/path)==digest,'source changed: '+path)
    require(json.loads((ROOT/INDEX).read_bytes())['geometry']['receipt']==index['geometry']['receipt'],
            'current geometry changed during preparation')
    data['source_sha256']=pins
    write(out/'inputs.json',data)
    write(out/'preparation.json',{'schema':'eoere_panel98_current_preparation/v1',
        'screw_count':count,'parent_geometry':layout['parent_geometry'],'import_proof':import_proof,
        'wall_proof':wall_proof,'new_contact_patch_count':len(patches),'direct_contact_count':len(direct+flange_contacts),
        'floor_reference':'retained four source points per foot; all confirmed on current solids; complete footprint pressure is unqualified',
        'input':{'path':str((out/'inputs.json').relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(out/'inputs.json')},
        'native_solve':False,'current_actions_or_acceptance_transferred':False,
        'structural_acceptance':False,'source_sha256':pins})
    return data


if __name__=='__main__':
    result=prepare(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(),Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(),int(sys.argv[3]))
    print(json.dumps({'screws':result['trial_screws'],'owners':len(result['physical_owner_gravity_rows']),
                      'cases':len(result['cases']),'contacts':len(result['direct_contacts'])}))

import csv

    charts=json.loads(field_path.read_bytes())['panel_generalized_coefficients']
    axes=[{**r['source_screw_descriptor'],'classification':'existing'} for r in data['hillman_rows']]
    axes += [{**r['axis'],'classification':'added'} for r in layout['added_axes']]
    assert len(axes)==98
    with csv_path.open('x',newline='') as f:
        w=csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['axis_id','panel','receiver','classification','analysis_front_x_mm','analysis_front_y_mm','analysis_front_z_mm','status'])
        for a in axes:
            w.writerow([a['axis_id'],a['panel'],a['receiver'],a['classification'],
                        *[f'{x:.6f}' for x in a['origin_xyz_mm']],'development proposal; not drilling instructions'])
    svg=['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 815" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
         '<title id="title">98-screw development proposal</title>',
         '<desc id="desc">Four main panels with the twelve existing screw axes and eight additions on each panel. Eighteen kicker screws are retained.</desc>',
         '<rect width="760" height="815" fill="#f8fafc"/>',
         '<g font-family="sans-serif" fill="#172a3a">',
         '<text x="30" y="30" font-size="22">98-screw layout trial — front view</text>',
         '<text x="30" y="54" font-size="13">20 per main panel; 18 kicker screws retained. Existing axes stay fixed.</text>',
         '<circle cx="39" cy="77" r="4" fill="#236b9b"/><text x="52" y="82" font-size="13">Existing</text>',
         '<circle cx="155" cy="77" r="5" fill="#bf5a16"/><text x="168" y="82" font-size="13">Added (eight per panel)</text>']
    positions={'main_upper_left':(45,130),'main_upper_right':(405,130),
               'main_lower_left':(45,475),'main_lower_right':(405,475)}
    for name,(ox,oy) in positions.items():
        chart=charts[name];g=chart['geometry'];origin=np.asarray(g['origin']);basis=np.asarray(g['axes'])
        scale=.245;width=chart['width_mm']*scale;height=chart['height_mm']*scale
        svg.append(f'<text x="{ox}" y="{oy-12}" font-size="14">{name.replace("main_","").replace("_"," ")} — 20 screws</text>')
        svg.append(f'<rect x="{ox}" y="{oy}" width="{width:.3f}" height="{height:.3f}" fill="white" stroke="#657985"/>')
        added_n=0
        for a in (r for r in axes if r['panel']==name):
            xy=(np.asarray(a['origin_xyz_mm'])-origin)@basis[:,:2]
            x,y=ox+xy[0]*scale,oy+height-xy[1]*scale
            color='#bf5a16' if a['classification']=='added' else '#236b9b'
            radius=5 if a['classification']=='added' else 3.8
            title=html.escape(a['axis_id']+' → '+a['receiver'])
            svg.append(f'<circle cx="{x:.3f}" cy="{y:.3f}" r="{radius}" fill="{color}"><title>{title}</title></circle>')
            if a['classification']=='added':
                added_n+=1
                svg.append(f'<text x="{x+7:.3f}" y="{y-5:.3f}" font-size="10" fill="{color}">+{added_n}</text>')
    svg.extend(['<text x="30" y="801" font-size="12">Placement proposal only. Strength, force sharing and installation remain separate checks.</text>', '</g></svg>'])
    with svg_path.open('x') as f:f.write('\n'.join(svg)+'\n')


if __name__=='__main__':
    render(*(Path(p).resolve() for p in sys.argv[1:4]))

"""Read-only raw-operator replay for current paired development candidates.

Reuses the independent geometric/force readers without asserting the older
production provenance contract. No stiffness assembly or equilibrium solve.
"""

import copy
import json
import sys
from contextlib import ExitStack
from pathlib import Path

from scripts import eoere_current_response as response
from scripts.eoere_current_shop_followup import ROOT, require, sha


def replay(path,out):
    require(not out.exists(),'fresh replay output required')
    before=sha(path)
    field=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    require(field['schema']=='eoere_panel98_current_fixed_floor_trial_candidate/v1'
            and field['response']['converged'] is True and not any(field['release'].values()),'own converged candidate required')
    fixed=response.load('bridge')
    b=fixed.frozen()
    centroidal=b.driver.load(b.driver.CENTROIDAL,b.driver.CENTROIDAL_SHA,'panel98_replay_centroidal')
    data=field['source_inputs']
    for name,digest in field['source_sha256'].items():require(sha(ROOT/name)==digest,'field source drift: '+name)
    snapshot=b.bundle.read_snapshot(field['operator_bundle'])
    require(snapshot.case==data['case'] and snapshot.case['loads']==field['body_applied_loads'], 'exact saved loads required')
    require(field['original_operator_fingerprint_sha256']==snapshot.manifest['original_operator_fingerprint_sha256'],
            'captured source operators differ')
    require(field['reference_interaction_descriptors']==[b.core.descriptor(r) for r in [*snapshot.groups,*snapshot.contacts,*snapshot.tangents]],
            'captured interaction descriptors differ')
    q=b.base.array(field['response']['q'],(snapshot.assembly.ndof,))
    with fixed.corrected_context(b),ExitStack() as stack:
        # Independent readers can have separate loaded factory modules.
        factories={id(f):f for f in (b.factory,b.base.factory,b.old_gate.base.factory)}
        for factory in factories.values():stack.enter_context(centroidal.correction_context(factory))
        maps=b.base.OwnedMaps(snapshot,data)
        b.base.verify_physical_bodies(snapshot,data)
        ports=b.base.verify_ports(snapshot,maps,data)
        work=b.base.verify_load_work(snapshot,maps,data)
        fresh=b.law.replay(snapshot.assembly.K,snapshot.applied,snapshot.groups,snapshot.contacts,snapshot.tangents,q)
        auditor=b.old_gate.declared_force_auditor()
        normals,closure=auditor(field,snapshot,q,fresh)
        require(all(normals[name]>1e-7 for name in b.law.RESTRAINED_HOSTS),'credited legs must bear')
        recovery=b.driver.ordered.verify_fitting_and_alias_recovery(field,snapshot,maps,q)
        # A small false force must be rejected by the same unchanged gate.
        false=copy.deepcopy(field)
        false['panel_screw_actions'][0]['force_on_first_xyz_n'][0]+=.01
        try:auditor(false,snapshot,q,fresh)
        except ValueError:negative=True
        else:raise ValueError('force-tamper control was not rejected')
    require(sha(path)==before,'field changed during read-only replay')
    result={'schema':'eoere_panel98_current_raw_operator_replay/v1','case_id':field['case_id'],
        'screws':field['trial_screws'],'field':{'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':before},
        'geometry':field['trial_parent_geometry'],'owned_ports':ports,'load_work':work,'equilibrium':closure,
        'fitting_recovery':recovery,'credited_rear_legs_in_compression':True,
        'false_screw_force_rejected':negative,'K_reassembled_or_equilibrium_resolved':False,
        'production_admission_issued':False,'complete_joint_or_Hillman_resistance_accepted':False,
        'source_sha256':{**field['source_sha256'],str(Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT)):sha(__file__)}}
    with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(b.core.serial(result),f,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps({'case':field['case_id'],'screws':field['trial_screws'],'replay':'pass','gradient':closure['gradient_inf_n']}))


if __name__=='__main__':replay(*(Path(s).resolve() for s in sys.argv[1:3]))

"""Paired development trials through unchanged first-order numerical kernels.

This does not issue the project's production field-admission receipt. Each
candidate keeps that requirement; raw-operator replay is recorded separately.
"""

import ast
import copy
import fcntl
import json
import signal
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np

from scripts import eoere_current_response as response
from scripts import eoere_panel_size_reference as sizes
from scripts import thin_bolted_panel_coupled as sections
from scripts.eoere_current_shop_followup import ROOT, require, sha

OWN=Path(__file__).resolve()
LOADED_SHA=sha(OWN)
SCHEMA='eoere_panel98_current_first_order_inputs/v1'


def write(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(response.load('bridge').frozen().core.serial(value),stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def validator(factory,count):
    """Change only schema and explicit screw/spacer inventory constants."""
    require(sha(factory.__file__)==factory.LOADED_SHA,'loaded frozen factory differs')
    tree=ast.parse(Path(factory.__file__).read_bytes())
    node=copy.deepcopy(next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='validate_rows'))
    edits={'screws':0,'roles':0,'shaft_roles':0}
    for part in ast.walk(node):
        if isinstance(part,ast.Compare) and ast.unparse(part.left)=="len(data['hillman_rows'])":
            require(ast.unparse(part)=='len(data[\'hillman_rows\']) == 66','original screw hook differs')
            part.comparators[0].value=count
            edits['screws']+=1
        if isinstance(part,ast.Constant) and part.value==500:
            part.value=508
            edits['roles']+=1
        if isinstance(part,ast.Compare) and ast.unparse(part.left)=="len(row['metal_roles'])":
            require(ast.unparse(part)=="len(row['metal_roles']) == 5",'original role hook differs')
            part.ops=[ast.In()]
            part.comparators=[ast.Tuple(elts=[ast.Constant(5),ast.Constant(6)],ctx=ast.Load())]
            edits['shaft_roles']+=1
    require(edits=={'screws':1,'roles':1,'shaft_roles':1},'exact three census hooks required')
    namespace={**vars(factory),'SCHEMA':SCHEMA}
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[])),str(OWN),'exec'),namespace)
    return namespace['validate_rows']


def panel_bank(data):
    prior_path=ROOT/'fea/generated/selected-hardware-followup-v1/current-response-v1/inputs-attempt05.json'
    require(sha(prior_path)=='316edd1dbb9b2200f752f938891ac4857928a90d062fbfcf96ef709ce93363dc','reference panel input changed')
    panels,_,pins,proof=response.load_panel_dependencies(json.loads(prior_path.read_bytes()))
    axes=[r['source_screw_descriptor'] for r in data['hillman_rows']]
    rows=[]
    with response.panel_context() as pb:
        for name,panel in panels.items():
            before={r['identity']:r for r in panel['holes']}
            holes=[{**r,'xy_mm':pb.plate.local_xy(r['start_xyz_mm'],panel['geometry']).tolist()}
                   for r in data['current_panel_machining_descriptors']['features'] if r['panel']==name]
            new={r['identity']:r for r in holes}
            require(all(new.get(k)==v for k,v in before.items()),'old aperture moved or removed')
            added=[r for r in holes if r['identity'] not in before]
            require(len(added)==(8 if data['trial_screws']==98 and name.startswith('main_') else 0),
                    'exact eight added apertures on each main panel required')
            if added:panel['K']=pb.raised.aperture_delta(panel,[],added)
            panel['holes']=holes
            pb.raised.refresh_screw_ports(panel,[r for r in axes if r['panel']==name])
            pb.mass.mass_only_quadrature(panel)
            panel['hole_area_mm2']=float(sum(np.pi*(r['diameter_mm']/2)**2 for r in holes))
            rows.append({'panel':name,'new_apertures':len(added),'screws':len(panel['screws']),
                         'K_sha256':pb.array_sha(panel['K']),'K_symmetry_error':float(abs(panel['K']-panel['K'].T).max())})
    observed={r['id']:r for r in data['finished_body_observations']}
    integrated={'panel_machining':data['current_panel_machining_descriptors'],'screw_axes':axes,
                'finished_stock':[{'name':name,'volume_mm3':observed[name]['volume_mm3'],
                                   'center_of_mass_xyz_mm':observed[name]['center_xyz_mm']} for name in data['panel_ids']],
                'panel_operator_source_inputs':{'current_trial':data['geometry'],'screws':data['trial_screws']}}
    pins[str(prior_path.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(prior_path)
    return panels,integrated,pins,{'source_bank':proof,'variant_panels':rows}


def diagnostics(field,panels,assembly,samples=41):
    q=np.asarray(field['response']['q'])
    screw_rows=[]
    for row in field['panel_screw_actions']:
        screw_rows.append(sections.screw_references(row,panels[row['panel']]['thickness']))
    rows=[]
    for name,panel in panels.items():
        coefficients=q[assembly.panel_offsets[name]]
        resolved=sections.panel_method.resolved_section_references(panel,coefficients,samples)
        adjusted={}
        for component,row in resolved['components'].items():
            if component=='bending_x':
                widths=sorted([panel['basis'].height,panel['geometry']['front_height']])
            elif component=='bending_y':widths=[panel['basis'].width]*2
            else:widths=None
            bounds=(sizes.adjusted_reference(row['peak_abs_resultant'],row['reference_per_mm_width_CD1'],widths)
                    ['adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1'] if widths else [row['sampled_ratio_CD1']]*2)
            adjusted[component]={**row,'size_adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1':bounds,
                                 'conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds':[v/1.6 for v in bounds]}
        rows.append({'panel':name,'components':adjusted})
    return {'schema':'eoere_panel98_trial_component_references/v1','case_id':field['case_id'],
            'screws':screw_rows,'panels':rows,'samples_per_axis':samples,
            'generic_head_capacity_not_Hillman_capacity':True,'complete_strength_acceptance':False,
            'raw_field_independent_admission_pending':True}


def run(input_path,case_id,out):
    require(not out.exists(),'fresh output required')
    data=json.loads(input_path.read_bytes())
    require(data['schema']==SCHEMA and data['trial_screws'] in (66,98),'own paired input required')
    require(not any(data['release'].values()),'all releases must remain false')
    for path,digest in data['source_sha256'].items():require(sha(ROOT/path)==digest,'input source changed: '+path)
    selected=[r for r in data['cases'] if r['case_id']==case_id]
    require(len(selected)==1,'one current source case required')
    data['case']=selected[0]
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    (out/'producer-snapshot.py').write_bytes(OWN.read_bytes())
    fixed=response.load('bridge')
    b=fixed.frozen()
    centroidal=b.driver.load(b.driver.CENTROIDAL,b.driver.CENTROIDAL_SHA,'panel98_trial_centroidal')
    start=time.monotonic()
    pins={**data['source_sha256'],str(input_path.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(input_path),str(OWN.relative_to(ROOT)):LOADED_SHA,
          'scripts/eoere_panel_size_reference.py':sha(ROOT/'scripts/eoere_panel_size_reference.py'),
          'scripts/thin_bolted_panel_coupled.py':sha(ROOT/'scripts/thin_bolted_panel_coupled.py')}
    panels,integrated,bank_pins,proof=panel_bank(data)
    pins=response.join(pins,bank_pins)
    write(out/'panel-bank.json',proof)
    print('Panel bank ready',flush=True)
    with fixed.corrected_context(b),patch.object(b.factory,'validate_rows',validator(b.factory,data['trial_screws'])), \
            centroidal.correction_context(b.factory):
        prepared=b.factory._prepare(data,panels,integrated,pins,synthetic=False)
        prepared.source_review={'schema':'eoere_panel98_trial_local_source_validation/v1',
            'input':{'path':str(input_path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(input_path)},
            'frozen_validator_numerical_checks_retained':True,'source_closure_verified':True,
            'external_independent_review_claimed':False,'production_field_admission_pending':True}
        write(out/'input-checks.json',prepared.source_review)
        command=list(sys.orig_argv)
        pointers=b.bundle.snapshot(prepared,arrays_path=out/'operators.npz',manifest_path=out/'operators.json',pins=pins,command=command)
        print('Current operators captured: '+str(prepared.counts),flush=True)
        def observe(event):
            with (out/'events.jsonl').open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(b.core.serial(event),allow_nan=False)+'\n')
        with patch.object(b,'FIELD_SCHEMA','eoere_panel98_current_fixed_floor_trial_candidate/v1'), \
                patch.object(b,'STATE_PREFIX','eoere-panel'+str(data['trial_screws'])+'-current-trial-'):
            execute=b.compile_execute(lambda extra=None:b.source_pins(extra))
            field=execute(prepared,pins=pins,command=command,mask_budget=1,max_iterations=300,branch_observer=observe)
        field.update(trial_screws=data['trial_screws'],trial_parent_geometry=data['geometry'],
                     operator_bundle=pointers,native_FEA_performed=False)
        b.old_runner.export_panel_coefficients(field,b.bundle.coordinate_map(prepared))
        write(out/'field.json',field)
        if field['response'].get('converged'):
            write(out/'components.json',diagnostics(field,panels,prepared.assembly))
        require(sha(OWN)==LOADED_SHA,'loaded trial adapter changed')
        summary={'screws':data['trial_screws'],'case':case_id,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,
                 'converged':field['response'].get('converged'),
                 'gradient_inf_n':field['response'].get('gradient_inf_n'),
                 'field':{'path':str((out/'field.json').relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(out/'field.json')},
                 'structural_acceptance':False}
        write(out/'result.json',summary)
        print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
        return summary


if __name__=='__main__':
    source,case,destination=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(),sys.argv[2],Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve()
    def expired(*_):raise TimeoutError('900-second trial wall limit reached; no automatic retry')
    with (ROOT/'docs/wood-joints-mvp/luna-max-native-run-ledger.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        require(json.loads((ROOT/'docs/wood-joints-mvp/luna-max-native-run-ledger.json').read_bytes())['slot']['state']=='idle',
                'parent native slot must be idle before reduced trial')
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,expired)
        signal.alarm(900)
        try:run(source,case,destination)
        except BaseException as error:
            destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            write(destination/'failure.json',{'error':repr(error),'accepted_actions':None,'accepted_q':None})
            (destination/'failed-producer-snapshot.py').write_bytes(OWN.read_bytes())
            raise
        finally:signal.alarm(0)

"""Independent decimal arithmetic and witness/count verification, no solve."""

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
getcontext().prec=60


def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify(path,out):
    before=sha(path)
    r=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    def require(value,message):
        if not value:raise ValueError(message)
    for key,producer in r['supporting_producers'].items():
        require(hashlib.sha256(producer['source'].encode()).hexdigest()==producer['sha256'],'embedded source differs: '+key)
    require(hashlib.sha256(r['producer']['source'].encode()).hexdigest()==r['producer']['sha256'],'embedded summary differs')
    pins=dict(r['source_sha256'])
    for pointer in r['reused_source_closures']:
        require(sha(ROOT/pointer['path'])==pointer['sha256'],'source closure changed')
        for name,digest in json.loads((ROOT/pointer['path']).read_bytes())['source_sha256'].items():
            require(pins.get(name,digest)==digest,'conflicting source closure')
            pins[name]=digest
    require(len(pins)==r['expanded_source_pin_count'],'expanded source count differs')
    for name,digest in pins.items():require(sha(ROOT/name)==digest,'source changed: '+name)
    checks=0
    for n,variant in r['variants'].items():
        totals={'head':0,'bending':0,'rolling':0};counts={key:0 for key in totals};maxima={key:D(0) for key in totals}
        for case in variant['cases']:
            source=case['component_references']
            require(sha(ROOT/source['path'])==source['sha256'],'component bytes changed')
            components=json.loads((ROOT/source['path']).read_bytes())
            for row in components['screws']:
                ratio=D(str(row['withdrawal_n']))/(D(str(row['generic_head_reference_n_CD1']))*D('1.6'))
                require(abs(ratio-D(str(row['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6'])))<D('1e-13'),'head ratio differs')
                totals['head']+=ratio>1;counts['head']+=1;maxima['head']=max(maxima['head'],ratio);checks+=1
            for panel in components['panels']:
                for key,row in panel['components'].items():
                    reference=D(str(row['reference_per_mm_width_CD1']))
                    factor=D(1)
                    if key=='bending_x' and panel['panel'].startswith('kicker'):
                        # Frozen chart height bounds supply the size reference.
                        field=json.loads((ROOT/case['raw_field']['path']).read_bytes())
                        chart=field['panel_generalized_coefficients'][panel['panel']]
                        widths=[D(str(chart['height_mm'])),D(str(chart['geometry']['front_height']))]
                        factor=min(D('.5') if w<D('203.2') else D('.25')+D('.0313')*w/D('25.4') if w<D('609.6') else D(1) for w in widths)
                    ratio=D(str(row['peak_abs_resultant']))/(reference*factor*D('1.6'))
                    require(abs(ratio-D(str(row['conditional_CD1p6_ratio_bounds'][1])))<D('1e-12'),'panel ratio or Cs differs')
                    group='bending' if key.startswith('bending') else 'rolling'
                    totals[group]+=ratio>1;counts[group]+=1;maxima[group]=max(maxima[group],ratio);checks+=1
        for family in totals:
            require(variant[family]['comparison_count']==counts[family]
                    and variant[family]['exceedances_conditional_CD1p6']==totals[family]
                    and abs(D(str(variant[family]['maximum_reference_index_conditional_CD1p6']))-maxima[family])<D('1e-12'),
                    'aggregate differs: '+n+'/'+family)
    require(r['case_coverage']['six_case_strength_or_force_envelope_established'] is False
            and not r['structural_acceptance'] and not r['climbing_released'],'scope/release changed')
    require(checks==1060,'five paired cases:820 head plus240 panel references required')
    for name,digest in pins.items():require(sha(ROOT/name)==digest,'source changed after verification')
    require(sha(path)==before,'receipt changed during verification')
    result={'schema':'eoere_panel98_trial_decimal_verification/v1','receipt':{'path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(path)},
            'decimal_precision':60,'arithmetic_references_verified':checks,'all_source_pins_verified':len(pins),
            'independent_raw_operator_replays_required_and_present':True,'six_case_envelope_or_strength_accepted':False,
            'producer':{'path':str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(__file__)}}
    with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(result))


if __name__=='__main__':verify(*(Path(s).resolve() for s in sys.argv[1:3]))
